function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

We have a tool: functions.musicCharts_getMostPlayed with parameters: genre, region, duration optional. We need to call this tool twice: once for pop globally (maybe region unspecified or maybe region empty string?), and once for rock in Australia.

But the tool requires region string. For global, maybe we can pass region as "global" or empty string? The spec says region: string. So we need to provide something. Possibly "global" or "world". But not sure. The user didn't specify region for pop. We could interpret as global. So region: "global".

We need to call the tool twice. We'll do two calls. We'll first call for pop globally. Then call for rock in Australia.

We should produce the tool calls in JSON format. We'll do them sequentially. We'll output the tool calls.
